🏁 - Welcome to Track and Field: Infinite! - 🏁

📓 - Description - 📓
Take your friends on in this ultimate battle of athleticism through sprints, hurdles, jumps, and most importantly, RELAYS, just like the Olympics! Prepare to fly high in style with custom blocks, particle effects, and much more with the shop interface and in-game currency. Will you rise to the top in Track & Field, the greatest measurement of athleticism?

🏃‍♂️ - Sprint Controls - 🏃‍♀️
PC: Spam Q and E
Mobile: Rapidly tap your screen
Controller: L1 and R1 (left and right bumpers)
